_source: Charlie's Desserts menu PDF, https://www.charliesdesserts.com/s/Charlies-Menu-2026.pdf (InDesign, created 7 Apr 2026, 2 A3 pages). Transcribed 28 Oct 2026 from the page images and checked against the PDF text layer. Frozen yoghurt from their Instagram post of 26 Oct 2026, https://www.instagram.com/p/De95MO1A9-o/. GBP. Named items keep their menu price. Additions on top use the list prices below. Never re price a named item by summing its parts.

rules.create_your_own_floor_text: Everything on our menu is available for your own creation from £5
rules.unknown: The menu doesn't say what a 'from £5.50' create your own base includes. The builder treats the base as plain and adds every sauce and topping at list price, labelled as an estimate for Danielle to confirm.

crepe_or_waffle.note: Choose a crepe or a waffle. Plain or available to create your own from £5.50. Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream for £2 or whippy ice cream for £4.

cookie_dough.note: Cookie dough, all £6.50. Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream for £2 or whippy ice cream for £4.

frozen_yoghurt.note: UNLIMITED standard toppings. Instagram 26 Oct 2026. Launched at 51 King St, Huddersfield (post of 23 Oct). Which toppings count as standard, and whether Brighouse serves it, isn't published.
